strategies.name: Detection of Exploitation for Privilege Escalation

analytics.name: Analytic 1871
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol commands succeeding against protected device functions from a source or session context that the device's documented access control model should reject, indicating exploitation of a vulnerability to bypass the device's privilege model. Documented as the core mechanism of the Triton attack, which exploited a zero-day in Triconex firmware while in PROGRAM mode. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

tuning.description: Time window within which a device/process crash and subsequent privileged action are considered correlated.
Documented hash/name signatures of known vulnerable drivers exploitable for privilege escalation (BYOVD technique).

log_sources.name: NSM:Connections
log_sources.channel: device process crash or unexpected restart immediately followed by privileged protocol command succeeding from same source session

log_sources.name: device:VendorLog
log_sources.channel: protected function (firmware write, memory protection mode change) succeeds for a session that did not complete the documented authentication/privilege-elevation sequence

analytics.name: Analytic 2261
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) operator/service account being granted elevated Windows privileges without a corresponding administrative logon event, or a process crash in an Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor application immediately followed by a new process inheriting elevated token privileges. Documented in PIPEDREAM's LAZYCARGO component, which drops and exploits a known vulnerable ASRock driver to elevate credentials. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action.
